claims.statement: Hammond Power Solutions' own Q2 2026 results release: it makes dry-type transformers, power quality products, related magnetics and power conversion systems; U.S. sales grew significantly year on year, driven by increases in data centre shipments; Q2 2026 backlog was 96.9% higher than a year earlier, primarily due to large project orders driven by data centre activity, though it fell 3.1% from Q4 2025 and 6.9% from Q1 2026 as shipments exceeded new bookings. sources.locator: p.3 About Hammond Power Solutions Inc.
sources.quote: Hammond Power Solutions Inc. (“HPS” or the “Company”) enables electrification through its broad range of dry-type transformers, power quality products, related magnetics and power conversion systems.

Demand in the U.S. market continues to be driven by data centre investment, electrification and power infrastructure spending, and our expanded manufacturing footprint is allowing us to support that growth more effectively.

Sales in the U.S. market in the second quarter grew significantly year-over-year, driven by increases in data centre shipments, along with modest improvements in industrial markets versus the first quarter of 2026 and 2025.

The Company’s Quarter 2, 2026 backlog increased by 96.9% as compared to Quarter 2, 2025, primarily due to large project orders driven by data centre activity. Backlog decreased 3.1% from Quarter 4, 2025 and 6.9% from Quarter 1, 2026, as shipments exceeded new order bookings during the period.
